title: The Crowns Due
subtitle: permissionLevel 4, past a payout block
description: `permissionLevel: 4` runs the command at the server's own level, for the rewards that must not depend on the player's rights. Level 2 is the default because most commands should be a command block's; this one is the exception.

`ignoreRewardBlocking: true` pays even while an operator has held the team's automatic payouts with `/tenet rewards block` — the hold's one sanctioned exception, for the reward that is a debt rather than a gift.
